name: Atlanta Teen Leader Program and Parks and Recreation Teen Summer Employment
org: City of Atlanta, Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Join free teen activities at city recreation centers, such as sneaker and fashion design, music, cooking, sports training, content creating and graphic design. Registered teens can be considered for Parks and Recreation summer jobs.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 18. Participating sites listed: Adams, Bessie Branham, C. T. Martin, Dunbar, Grove Park, Martin Luther King Jr., Peachtree Hills, Pittman, Rosel Fann, Thomasville, William Walker, Zaban, @Promise South and @Promise MLK. Residency rules are not stated.
pay_detail: Teen Leader activities are free. Pay for the summer employment program is not stated in the catalog.
duration: The 2026 Teen Leaders Summer Academy ran June 8 to July 24, Monday to Friday.
deadline_text: The catalog says teens must be registered prior to December 31, 2026 to be considered for the Parks and Recreation summer employment program, and that registration is ongoing. That date is a registration cutoff, not a job application. The catalog also says summer 2026 employment registration is closed.
how_to_apply: Register for the Atlanta Teen Leader Program. The catalog lists atlantaga.gov/iparcs as the City registration site for its programs. Confirm the steps with your nearest participating recreation center.
notes: Source is the City's 2026 summer catalog, so it does not say which summer the Dec 31, 2026 registration cutoff is for. Ages and pay for the actual summer jobs are not stated. Georgia requires a work permit for any job under 16. The City's iParcs page blocked automated reading.
